text:
tanya: quick heads-up  found a broken inline gist link in the 'serve-fast' guide that slipped past the last localization backport. The English page references gist.github.com/rdw/serve-examples#L12 but the localized page kept the old shortlink and the example embed returns 404 in staging. anyone owning serve-fast?

eric: can you paste both urls? i'll spin up a local staging to verify.

tanya: sure
EN: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/serve-fast#example-embed
PT: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/pt/guides/serve-fast#example-embed (embed references https://gist.github.com/rdw/old-serve-examples)

bot-linkscan: linkcheck: external gist 404 detected (referrer: /pt/guides/serve-fast). first seen 2025-09-02.

mina: localization usually updates gist permalinks during backport. if the gist was replaced we should either update the embed URL or rehost the snippet in the repo and use a local include.

eric: i prefer rehosting to avoid external dependency in docs. small plan: copy snippet into docs/snippets/serve-fast-example.md and change embed to internal include. will open PR with relocation and update both EN/PT pages to point at internal snippet.

localization: if you rehost, please add a locale note so translators know the snippet was rehosted and can verify language-specific instructions still match. we'll approve quick backport.

tanya: also asking docs-ci: can we add a cheap smoke test that dereferences included snippets and fails CI if an external gist is referenced? we've seen flakiness with third-party assets.

docs-ci: good idea. we can add a lint rule that flags external gist.github.com URLs in docs. For this PR we can include a one-off smoke curl that ensures the new internal include returns 200. We'll accept the microtest under smoke/quickchecks.

eric: local sed I used to patch the file before opening the PR:
```bash
# create local snippet file
mkdir -p docs/snippets && cp scripts/examples/serve_fast_example.md docs/snippets/serve-fast-example.md

# replace gist embed line in pt guide with internal include
sed -i "s@<script src=\"https://gist.github.com/rdw/old-serve-examples.js\"></script>@{% include_relative ../../snippets/serve-fast-example.md %}@g" pt/guides/serve-fast.md

# smoke: ensure include resolves (200)
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/pt/guides/serve-fast"
``` 

mina: thanks. tag me for review, i'll verify snippet content and keep localization in the loop. Also add a KB note under /kb/snippet-rehost-reasons so we have the decision history (privacy / reliability).

eric: PR opened: #4987-rehost-serve-snippet. changes: add docs/snippets/serve-fast-example.md, replace gist embed in en + pt pages, add smoke curl in docs-smoke/quick. requesting review tanya, mina; cc localization and docs-ci.

tanya: LGTM. minor ask: in the PR description add the original gist URL and the rehost rationale. we use that for post-mortem tracking.

docs-ci: received. will run the quick smoke for the PR and validate no external gist links remain. we will also add a lint followup to flag gist.github.com references in future PRs.

eric: thanks everyone. aiming to merge today since it's low-risk and fixes a visible 404 in staging.

localization: will backport PT once merged, closing the l10n ticket.

tanya: thanks all. filing a short KB entry and marking this as a 'docs reliability' microfix :memo:
